review.notes: Original Modern Standard Georgian teaching examples authored and self-reviewed by AI. Independent native Georgian review remains pending. Mkhedruli is the teaching script; no approved pronunciation or audio is claimed. Verb vocabulary uses masdars (verbal nouns), including explicitly labelled practical verb phrases, rather than claiming Georgian has English-style infinitives.
